title: Desk phone (ShoreTel IP 230)
summary: Answer, transfer, voicemail, and send unsettled calls to email.

la: Answer the Lab phone and transfer calls

cells: Lift the handset or press Speaker. Dial the extension, or 9 then the outside number.
Press Transfer, dial the extension, press Transfer again.
Press Confrn, dial the second person, press Confrn again.

sections.title: Call handling mode
sections.text: Press the **Mode** softkey: **Standard** for normal use, **In a Meeting** sends calls to voicemail, **Out of Office** sends calls to the backup line.

sections.title: Voicemail
steps: Follow the prompts to listen or delete.

sections.title: A call you can't settle
sections.script: Thank you for calling the UNG Language Lab. So your request is on record and reaches the right person, please email {email} with your full name, your class (for example, SPAN 1001, section 02) and your question.
sections.note: Same rule as at the desk: see [Student questions](#/email-first).
